description: Find FDIC-insured banks and savings institutions by name, CERT, location, size, charter class, or holding company — including closed, merged, and failed institutions. Name matching is fuzzy, case-insensitive, and also matches former and trade names (a result says which it matched); every word must match. Returns institution records keyed by CERT, the FDIC certificate number every other fdic_ tool takes, with active status, successor CERT for merged or failed institutions, holding company, and latest reported assets and deposits. Credit unions are insured by the NCUA and are not in this data.

bank_classes.description: Charter classes to include: N national bank, NM state nonmember bank, SM state member bank, SB federal savings bank, SI state savings bank, SL state savings and loan, OI insured branch of a foreign bank, NC noninsured non-deposit trust company.

items.description: Charter class code, uppercase; fdic_list_reference topic bank_classes lists them.

certs.description: Exact lookup by up to 50 CERTs; requested CERTs with no record come back in missing_certs.

city.description: Headquarters city as FDIC spells it (e.g. Seattle, St. Louis), up to 50 characters; matched exactly, as given or in title case, with a hyphen, apostrophe, or space between words also tried the other ways FDIC records it (Winston-Salem finds Winston Salem, Coeur d'Alene finds Coeur D Alene).

holding_company_rssd.description: Holding company RSSD ID from any result's holding_company.rssd; lists the institutions under that top holder. With status any, former subsidiaries are included under the holder they had at closing.

max_assets.description: Maximum latest reported total assets, in thousands of US dollars.

min_assets.description: Minimum latest reported total assets, in thousands of US dollars (1000000 = $1 billion).

name.description: Institution name to match, up to 100 characters — current, former, or trade name, case-insensitive, every word required (e.g. "silicon valley"). Punctuation other than & ' . , - is ignored, and so is a standalone N.A. or NA, which then also matches "National Association".

offset.description: Matches to skip (0–100,000); pass next_offset from the previous page.

sort.description: relevance (active institutions whose current name holds every word of name first, then every other match, each by match score; default when name is given — without name it falls back to assets_desc), assets_desc (largest first; the default otherwise), or name (A–Z).

state.description: Headquarters state: two-letter code in any case (wa) or full name (Washington); DC and territories accepted.

status.description: active, inactive (merged, failed, or closed), or any. Default: any when name or certs is given, otherwise active. The applied value is echoed as status_filter.

name: fdic_search_institutions

cap.description: The limit applied to this page.

data_as_of.description: When FDIC last rebuilt the institutions index (ISO timestamp).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: state is not a US state, DC, or territory code or name. `invalid_asset_range`: min_assets exceeds max_assets. `invalid_name`: name has no letter or digit once normalized. `pacer_shed`: This server's shared FDIC request queue is saturated and the call would wait past its budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: FDIC answered 429 and retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: One institution record; an optional field is absent when FDIC holds no value for it.

active.description: True while the charter is open and insured; false after a merger, failure, or closing.

bank_class.description: Charter class; fdic_list_reference topic bank_classes lists every code.

code.description: FDIC charter class code, e.g. N, NM, SM, SB.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (CERT) — the key every other fdic_ tool takes.

domestic_offices.description: Domestic offices at the latest report.

ended_on.description: Date the charter ended by merger, failure, or closing (YYYY-MM-DD); inactive only.

fed_rssd.description: Federal Reserve RSSD ID of the institution.

holding_company.description: Top-tier holding company; absent when the institution has none on record.

rssd.description: Federal Reserve RSSD ID of the holding company; pass as holding_company_rssd.

last_report_date.description: Quarter-end date of the latest Call Report on file (YYYY-MM-DD).

matched_on.description: Present when a name search matched a former name or trade name rather than the current name.

field.description: Which kind of name matched the query.

text.description: The matched former or trade name.

name.description: Current legal name; for an inactive institution, its name at closing.

regulator.description: Primary federal regulator, e.g. OCC, FED, FDIC.

successor_cert.description: CERT of the institution that continued the franchise after a merger or failure.

total_assets.description: Total assets at the latest report (last report before closing if inactive), USD thousands.

total_deposits.description: Total deposits at the latest report, USD thousands.

missing_certs.description: Requested CERTs that match no institution record.

items.description: A requested CERT with no institution record.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; present when more matches remain.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the page is past the end, or more pages remain.

total.description: Institutions matching the filters across all pages.

truncated.description: True when more matches remain beyond this page.

title: Search FDIC-insured institutions
